Reconstruct ONLY the background of the TOP LEFT landing page panel. On the RIGHT HALF, a broad winding S-shaped powder blue river runs down from upper middle around x65%, curves toward right edge at y35%, curves left near x62% y65%, continues toward lower middle edge. Along the outer right bank run numerous SHORT widely spaced cobalt, red, yellow, teal and black strokes and dots. ONE small elegant black sailboat with red/cobalt/yellow round cargo on the river at x77%,y64%. The entire LEFT 50% is clean off-white for large text. Very small hint of water and colorful dots in extreme lower left corner. Top-left/header zone white. River should be broad, fluid and blue, not a tight swirl or giant multicolored wallpaper. Reference's soft watercolor grain, hand-painted riverbanks.
